items.title: Poland in shock after 6 killed in Krakow far-right shooting
items.summary: Poland on Sunday launched a terror probe into the mass shooting in Krakow the day before, in which six people were killed and many more were injured. Authorities have said that the 24-year-old suspect, who used a semi-automatic rifle in his killing spree, was “fascinated by far-right ideologies”. He is currently in critical condition in hospital. FRANCE 24 journalist Adrien Sariat reports from Poland.

items.title: Mourning in Poland after mass shooting

Two days of national mourning have been declared for the victims.
